message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, translucent green letters across the top center. The composition features multiple green-line sketches of the same man in different poses, overlaid on a light grey background with a red vertical border on the left.

The central figure is shown four times: at the bottom, he wears a black songkok hat and a suit, with his mouth open and hands raised in a claw-like gesture. Above him, he is shown three more times: once in a suit with his hand raised in a two-finger salute; once wearing a hat, face mask, and sunglasses; and once smiling with a scarf around his neck. Ghostly, translucent hand sketches in various gestures surround these figures.

Large green text on the left reads "ROMY, AKHIRNYA". Below this, smaller black text describes a person being arrested by a commission. The top of the cover contains text regarding "INVESTIGASI: ORANG UTAN" and "PROTOKOL HANTU OPERASI SAMBHAR". A barcode and date "18-24 MARET 2019" are located at the bottom.
